stories.headline: Fed rate-hike odds surge to 90% as core inflation runs hot
stories.summary: Markets now price a 90% chance the Federal Reserve raises rates by 25bp at its Sept 16 meeting after August core CPI came in hotter than expected. The 10-year Treasury closed at its highest yield since 2007, with oil above $100 adding pressure.

stories.headline: Labor and Coalition hold immigration talks as Malinauskas warns of 'race to the bottom'
stories.summary: The federal government is negotiating immigration policy with the opposition while SA Premier Peter Malinauskas warns the major parties against a 'political race to the bottom' with One Nation on migration cuts.

stories.headline: Ukraine's prosecutor general resigns amid corruption scandal
stories.summary: Ruslan Kravchenko quit as Ukraine's top prosecutor after an anti-corruption probe exposed an alleged protection racket run from his office shielding scam call centres, the latest casualty among senior Zelensky allies.

stories.headline: NASA and IBM release open-source AI foundation model for lunar science
stories.summary: The NASA-IBM Lunar Foundation Model, trained on ~2 million images from the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, helps scientists map craters, spot young volcanic features and predict where lunar polar ice may be stable. Free on Hugging Face.

stories.headline: AI plots an interstellar trajectory to Alpha Centauri
stories.summary: The Fermi Explorer Mission aims to launch a probe to our nearest star system by 2029, using an orbital route discovered by an AI physics tool, Get Physics Done, from the startup Physical Superintelligence.

stories.headline: Oil tops $100 a barrel as the US–Iran conflict escalates
stories.summary: Brent crude rose above $101 in the latest tit-for-tat exchange of fire between the US and Iran, the first time since July. The spike is compounding inflation fears and reinforcing bets on higher central-bank rates.

stories.headline: 18th BRICS Summit opens in New Delhi as Modi hosts Putin and Xi
stories.summary: India hosts the 18th BRICS Summit at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on Sep 12–13 under its 2026 chairship, with Narendra Modi hosting Vladimir Putin, Xi Jinping and the bloc's leaders for talks on trade, finance and a shared currency agenda.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia's oil 'lifeline' attacked as oil climbs toward $110
stories.summary: Attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure compounded an already-tight market, pushing crude toward $110 a barrel, deepening inflation pressure and keeping Treasury yields elevated on rate-hike bets.

stories.headline: Europe's maize harvest at 50-year low as soil deficits deepen
stories.summary: France's maize harvest hit a 50-year low and Romania is losing over a million hectares, with 2026 soil moisture deficits running 5 to 11 times more likely under climate-driven drought, straining EU agricultural policy.

stories.headline: Coalition warns Labor 'failed' on immigration as migration talks continue
stories.summary: Liberal frontbencher Andrew Hastie said Coalition MPs believe Labor has 'failed' on immigration, even as the two major parties hold private negotiations to find common ground on net overseas migration targets.

stories.headline: Houthis consolidate control over Bab al-Mandab as Red Sea shipping faces new threat
stories.summary: Yemen's Houthis moved to consolidate power over the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a vital maritime choke point, pledging not to disrupt international shipping while reiterating threats against Saudi-linked vessels.

stories.headline: World marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
stories.summary: On the 25th anniversary of the September 11, 2001 attacks, the UN Secretary-General honoured victims, survivors and first responders, calling the assault 'an assault on humanity itself', as US politicians gathered at the World Trade Center site.

stories.headline: Oil surges toward $110 a barrel as more ships struck near Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Additional vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices toward $110 a barrel and pushed US diesel above $6 a gallon for the first time, an energy shock feeding into inflation and rates expectations.

stories.headline: Documentary 'NAZA' reveals Israel's AI targeting systems in Gaza
stories.summary: A new documentary exposes how Israeli forces use AI-powered systems to select targets in Gaza, reigniting global debate over autonomous and AI-assisted targeting in dense urban warfare.

stories.headline: Wholesale inflation climbs as Houthi shipping disruption raises costs
stories.summary: Rising wholesale inflation, partly driven by energy and shipping disruption from the Red Sea conflict, added to pressure on the Reserve Bank amid the global inflation repricing.

stories.headline: Rubio wraps South America tour after winning new security cooperation
stories.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio wrapped up a South America tour after securing new security cooperation agreements, part of a broader US push to counter influence in the region.
